title: Sajjad Nu Ay Manzar, Bulna Nay Zindagi Sari
body:
Zainab De Sir To’n Chadar, Jadon Shimmr Ne Uthari
<<DIVIDER>>
Bazaar Shaam De Vich, Keetay Loghkan Ne Sawal Ay
Puchday Ne Shaami Hoye, Keray Zulm Teray Naal Ay
Kuj Bolda Nay Qaidi, Akhiyan Cho Rat Hay Jaari
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar Nu Babay Keeta, Ek Kurte Vich Dafan Ay
Babay Ghareeb Nu Vi, Milya Nai Kafan Ay
Menu Lord Nai Kafan Di, Kar Dafan Di Tiyari
<<DIVIDER>>
Margaye Behn Meri, Vich Shaam Rokay Akhay
Adi Raat Velay Abid, Mayat Sakina Chaway
Raya Dair Taen Labda, Ja Dafan Laye Muhari
<<DIVIDER>>
Tak Haal Mera Ronda, Naizay Te Sir Bhira Da
Baqir Da Baba Rukhja, Ho Beer Gay Zyada
Mai Dhi Batool Di Haan, Mahool Hay Bazari
<<DIVIDER>>
Enj Lutiya Zalima Ne, Koi Cheez Na Rahi Hay
Zainab Nu Daen Pursa, Aya Najaf To Ali Ay
Labdi Rehi Ay Chadar, Tak Babe Di Sawari
<<DIVIDER>>
Din Sara Chup Heh Rehndi, Kar Zulm Na Kameena
Jadon Raat Howay Rondi, Babay Nu Hy Sakina
Zindan Shaam To Puch, Jivain Qaid Iss Guzari
<<DIVIDER>>
Aulad Vaalay Rishtay, Muk Gay Meray Sajjad Ay
Akhay Rubab Dhi Da, Mu Akhri Vakha Day
Mere Khali Godh Kargaye, Asghar Di Behn Pyaari
<<DIVIDER>>
Tanveer Akhay Zainab, Bul Janda Apna Parda
Lagda Jo Taziyana, Abid Zamee Te Digda
Meray Hath Banday Ne Veeran Teri Behn Di Lechari
